prompt: When Justin Trudeau was elected as Prime Minister of Canada, who was the current Prime Minister of France?
answer: When Justin Trudeau became Prime Minister of Canada in November 2015, **Manuel Valls** was the Prime Minister of France. Valls served from **March 31, 2014, to December 6, 2016**.
